arguments.literal: declared evaluation family + exact workspace and topology basis + finite material relations and coordinates + applicable invariants and authorities + admissible evidence and exclusions + actor capability envelope = activated reference frame -> one member of the result algebra of ACTIVATION section 3.
P0

The actor or the assigning authority selects one frame or one declared active frame configuration capable of the evaluation. Activation binds each reusable frame declaration to the exact subject and basis and loads the declared material relations and evidence sources, never an undifferentiated workspace dump; what the actor receives is the packet of REFERENCE_FRAME section 11.
P0, P5

The minimum activation packet contains: frame identity and revision; the evaluation and its result algebra; the exact subject and basis; the material relations and applicable invariants; semantic, evaluation, operation where material, and decision authority; admissible evidence and tools; the capability and context envelope; exclusions and prohibited assumptions; declared frame dependencies or conjunction outputs; and invalidation, stop and reconfiguration conditions.
P0
An actor receives one activated frame or one declared active frame configuration, never an implied demand to reconstruct the complete workspace from ambient context.
P0

Atomic is said at engagement altitude only. One frame may carry several semantic atoms and several owner relations without merging their meaning or authority, and one semantic atom may take part in several frames. Where an adopting method supplies a semantic-contraction law for its domain atoms, that law governs the domain atom family. A frame set is not contracted to a disjoint minimum because its material variables overlap.
Authority is never minted from capability, a label or reachability.

Authority takes the kinds frame-set authority, semantic authority, evaluation authority, operation authority and decision authority; actor identity (the human, agent, tool or process performing the work) is an identity and not an authority. These may coincide in a lawful case and never collapse by default. Human authority may act directly or through an explicitly admitted bounded proxy where the governing identity and authority law permits it; proxy identity and human-authority identity stay distinct.
P6, P3
A basis is immutable, or moving with a declared way of detecting advancement and a declared condition for reevaluation; mixed bases need an explicit composite relation.
P6, P3

Every field resolves through stable identities and source references. Paths, line numbers, member counts, summaries and matching labels may aid navigation or diagnostics; they do not substitute for the declared identity and basis.
P3
The same frame may be usable by one actor and unusable by another; actor capability may justify a different frame size or activation sequence and can neither waive an invariant nor widen authority.
P0, P6
A changed governing relation is accepted only at its owner; accepting it inside the acting frame is a violation, whatever the size of the delta.

A claim's quantifier, population and scope cannot exceed its evaluated evidence; generalising a local observation needs a declared inference relation, the comparable population and explicit counterexample treatment.

A closed result identifies the frame and its activation, the subject, the basis, the evaluation, the actor, the evidence, the verdict, the residual uncertainty and the invalidation conditions; the minimal shape is REFERENCE_FRAME section 13.
P4b, P0
Compute the material closure of the seed set under the relation family on the exact basis; if the closure is not finite and unique, the step returns a gap or refusal and does not guess.

For the context dimension the fit test is a measurement: the bytes of the selected context are measured before any read and compared with the declared cap; the measurement, the cap and the outcome are step-produced facts recorded before the read.

An activated frame is one frame declaration bound to an exact evaluation, workspace subject, basis, actor and evidence-acquisition boundary; a reusable declaration is not evidence that a particular activation was correct.
P3, P6
Declaring, selecting, activating or executing a frame grants no semantic, operation or decision authority.
P6

The evaluator applies the activated frame's declared invariants, evidence rules and result algebra. It distinguishes semantic law, observed evidence, inference and decision, and records every assumption whose failure could change the result.
P6
Neither evidence nor authority is minted by the other.
Evidence becomes neither semantic truth nor decision authority by being available inside a frame; each item carries provenance, subject identity, basis and scope.
P6

Within its grant a step selects refinement, sequencing and compression itself; selecting another actor or enlarging the envelope re-enters the owner of the grant or envelope, who may delegate that choice in the grant.
The selected context fits the envelope.
Activate.

If it does not fit, one or more of these, in combination: refine the outer contract into steps whose contexts fit; sequence activations; apply a lawful compression; select another actor whose envelope fits; or return out_of_frame.

A frame is bound when every material coordinate of the tuple resolves to an exact source, subject, basis, authority, evidence route, actor envelope, result relation and invalidation condition; the binding may be expressed entirely in source-linked prose, and representation cannot create, widen or replace it.
P3, P6

The reference frame is the atomic engagement unit: the unit activated and evaluated as one bounded context. Frame-set selection, activation, evaluation, conjunction, translation, coverage and revision are separate functions over it. A frame supports a bounded evaluation without first containing a universal theory of its possible relationships.
P0

A candidate frame is qualified in proportion to its claims. The minimum evaluation asks: 1 decision test (can a competent actor produce a result in the declared algebra for representative in-domain evaluations); 2 reconstruction test (can a fresh competent actor activate the frame from the declared packet without hidden history); 3 sensitivity test (do changes to declared material relations affect the result where expected); 4 irrelevance test (do excluded unrelated changes leave the result stable); 5 basis test (does stale, mismatched or ambiguous basis information invalidate or refuse the evaluation); 6 authority test (does frame selection preserve semantic and decision authority and the exact inherited operation authority for every material operation); 7 counterexample test (does the frame detect the representative violations it claims to cover); 8 capability test (can the declared actor class hold and operate the frame within its envelope); 9 result-consumption test (can a declared consumer use the closed result without importing hidden frame context).
P6, P2

A reference frame F is the tuple (Q evaluation family; B workspace and topology basis; M material-relation manifold; C coordinate and equality law; I invariant set; A authority relation; E admissible evidence and provenance law; X exclusion and prohibited-assumption set; R closed result algebra of ACTIVATION section 3; J invalidation and rechart condition; K actor capability envelope; D optional declared dependencies, overlaps, inputs and outputs involving other frames). The tuple specifies the relation; it is not a required schema or runtime carrier. Operationally a frame is an evaluation contract that defines the finite attention scope one evaluation family requires.
P0, P2

Each of the following is a violation where it supports a frame or coverage claim: 1 one omniscient frame presumed to contain the complete method or workspace; 2 a module, file, service, role, persona, prompt or lens called a frame without a declared evaluation relation; 3 functional decomposition, authority hierarchy and frame topology silently treated as one tree; 4 every active frame required to compose with every other; 5 composition machinery introduced without a material cross-frame evaluation; 6 frame selection or broad visibility treated as semantic authority; 7 evidence flattened across bases or coordinates and treated as one executed or observed relation; 8 satisfied returned where the lawful result is indeterminate, out_of_frame or invalid_basis; 9 coverage inferred from artifact, file, operation, test, review or actor count; 10 a frame silently grown beyond the selected actor's capability envelope; 11 a topology mutation reusing a stale activation without recharting; 12 every failure creating another frame before activation, basis, evidence, capability and evaluation defects are excluded; 13 intentional overlap contracted although it supplies independently activated failure detection or materially different capability fit; 14 a generic runtime, registry, controller or universal carrier presented as required by the member.

The actor may own its internal reasoning and search where the governing method permits. It returns through the declared result relation. Hidden internal reasoning is no substitute for required evidence, provenance or authority. Frame size is optimised for reliable evaluation, not for maximum context loading: a more capable actor may activate a broader frame and a less capable one may use a lawful refinement sequence, and both preserve the same material invariants and authority relations.
Whether two activations of one actor family are independent for a semantic judgment is a policy the governing basis states for the claim.
Where no policy is stated, the default is that they are not independent.
A step is activated from an intake sufficient to reconstruct its governing relations without conversation history, commentary or a prior actor's memory.

The intake names: the governed outcome or decision it serves; the exact workspace subject and basis, and the inputs it may acquire, each by identity and hash or by an input commit; the evaluation or evaluation family and its result algebra; the affected relation set and the invariants that govern it; the applicable frame-set, semantic, evaluation, operation where material, and decision authority, and the grant (operations permitted, territory that may change, decisions reserved to others); the available actor capability envelopes; the conditions that make the result stale or out of scope and those that require re-entry at an owning relation; and, where the governed question is capability fit or a cost claim, the allowance and how spend will be measured.
The actor's internal path within a step is not part of the output and is not governed.

Semantic law defines what an evaluation means; evidence supplies observations; the evaluator applies the declared relation; decision authority disposes; one actor may perform several and the record keeps them distinguishable.

A lens is a reusable family of questions applied across a frame configuration; it becomes a frame only when instantiated with a bounded evaluation, basis, material manifold, evidence, authorities, result algebra and capability envelope.
P2
Materiality is evaluation-relative: a relation material in one frame may be irrelevant in another; the relation family of ACTIVATION section 2 is the material relations of a step.
P2, P6

The minimal activation binding, in Markdown or any consumer-selected carrier, is headed 'Reference-Frame Activation: <stable activation identity>' and holds: Frame (declaration identity and revision; exact evaluation and closed result algebra); Subject And Basis (exact subject or candidate identity; workspace, authority, dependency, configuration and time basis); Attention Surface (material relations and applicable invariants; exact source and semantic references; explicit exclusions and prohibited assumptions); Actor And Authority (actor and capability envelope; semantic and evaluation authority; operation authority, subject and territory where material; decision, acceptance and publication authority); Evidence And Relations (admissible evidence and acquisition route; dependency, overlap, input, conjunction or translation relations used; expected result consumer and return relation); Stop And Change (invalidation conditions; stop, residual, re-entry and reconfiguration conditions).

The minimal evaluation result is headed 'Frame Evaluation Result' and holds the fields: frame identity and revision; activation identity; evaluation; subject and basis; actor and capability envelope; semantic, evaluation, operation where material, and decision authority; admissible evidence; result; inference relation; residual uncertainty; invalidation conditions; consuming decision or conjunction. The result field holds one member of the result algebra of ACTIVATION section 3.

The minimal frame declaration is headed 'Frame: <stable local identity>' and has the sections: Evaluation Family (questions, predicates, and closed result algebra); Subject And Basis (workspace boundary, exact identity, version, time and topology coordinates); Material Manifold (entities, variables, relations, states, and interactions); Coordinates And Equality (how positions are distinguished and related); Invariants (applicable governing laws); Authorities (frame-set, semantic, evaluation, operation where material, and decision authority); Evidence (admissible sources, provenance, and exclusions); Capability Envelope (competence, context, access, tools, evaluation or assurance independence, configuration); Boundary And Exclusions (irrelevant material, prohibited assumptions, and out-of-frame conditions); Optional Frame Relations (inputs, outputs, overlaps, conjunctions, or translations actually used); Invalidation And Recharting (changes that stale this frame or its results); Qualification (representative cases, counterexamples, and known residuals). It is sufficient as written in Markdown or any other consumer-selected carrier.

Where evidence is missing because a relation or capability needed to obtain it was not declared, the result is out_of_frame; indeterminate is reserved for the case where the declared capability was exercised and the admissible evidence still cannot decide.
A step, claim or result binds one exact immutable basis; mixed bases need an explicit composite relation.
When no available frame and actor pairing can lawfully perform the evaluation, activation returns a refusal or out_of_frame; work does not proceed through implied context.
P0, P5
The method does not require proving that no undiscovered material relation exists.
A missing, failed or out-of-scope result returns its own member, never satisfied.
A finite actor realises a selected outer contract through steps; each step's selected context fits the actor's envelope; the actor's internal path within a step is its own.
Standing: recovered as a composite; the generic statement is reframed from the graph profile's graph functions.

A step can meet a condition outside its context and cannot report success on one; its result algebra carries indeterminate, out_of_frame and invalid_basis as first-class outcomes and its control model names the next move.
Standing: derived.
Definitions, assumptions, observations, candidate judgments and accepted claims have distinct standing; evidence supports a claim on a basis; authority permits or disposes within scope.
Standing: independent. A bounded actor satisfying all else can still take a green label as acceptance.
The actor of one step need not be the actor of the next; a later actor may re-acquire declared sources but not a prior actor's private memory.
A step's output is a candidate until evaluated.
The world is open: a step may meet conditions outside its selected context.
P0 presupposes a selected outcome (P2).
A projection cannot trim a required member to fit a carrier or budget.
A prompt, a context packet, a symbolic program or any other representation is a projection of an activated frame, not the frame.
P1

Project the closure to the selected context, recording its boundary: the excluded, external, unresolved, translated and invalidation-sensitive seams; material not in the closure stays out; adjacent material does not enter because it exists.

A human decision may be exercised directly or through an explicitly admitted bounded proxy whose grant names its scope and exclusions; a proxy cannot change Product meaning, requirements, governing authority or accepted design; such a change re-enters at its owning relation.

Qualification binds the exact frame revision, actor envelope, evaluation family, basis class and evidence conditions evaluated. It does not generalise to an unevaluated population by naming the frame generically.
P6
A read-only evaluation declares no operation authority; an effectful evaluation inherits the exact operation grant from its existing owner, and the frame does not create that grant.
P6
A declared refinement answers a different question, keeps its own vocabulary and declares a total mapping to the core; no refinement adds a core member.
One core algebra of exactly these five members serves every evaluation and every step's stop state.
Every frame declares the evaluation family it supports. A frame with no declared evaluation family has no testable sufficiency boundary.
P2

An activated frame contains a finite attention surface that fits the selected actor's declared capability envelope. A frame that needs undeclared ambient memory, conversation history or an effectively global workspace context is not reconstructable for that actor. ACTIVATION section 2 measures the fit where the contract selects measurement.
P0

Every known relation whose lawful change can alter the evaluation result, the validity of the basis, the sufficiency of evidence, operation authority or decision authority appears in the frame or enters through a declared authoritative input. Omitting a material relation makes the frame insufficient. The law does not require proving that no undiscovered material relation exists.
P2; P0 with the open-world premise

Relations that cannot affect the declared evaluation stay outside active attention unless they are needed to establish that irrelevance. A frame does not expand because adjacent workspace material exists.
P2

Every result binds its exact subject, basis, coordinates and evidence scope. A stale, advanced, ambiguous or mismatched basis returns invalid_basis or requires reactivation. Apparent equality never substitutes for declared coordinate equality.
P3, P1

A frame carries and applies admitted authority. It does not mint, widen, transfer or reconstruct semantic, evaluation, operation or decision authority from actor identity, available capability, evidence shape, implementation reachability or frame selection.
P6

Semantic law defines what the evaluation means; evidence supplies observations; the evaluator applies the declared relation; where the evaluation performs a material operation the existing operation owner supplies the exact grant; decision authority disposes the result. A frame declaration keeps these roles distinguishable even when one actor lawfully performs several of them. EVALUATION section 2 applies this to review.
P6

Frames may share entities, variables, evidence or coordinates. Shared material establishes neither identical meaning nor identical basis, authority or result. Every cross-frame equality or translation an evaluation uses is declared where it is used.
P1, P3

Every evaluation returns a member of its declared result algebra. The core algebra is defined once, in ACTIVATION section 3 (satisfied, falsified, indeterminate, out_of_frame, invalid_basis) with the no-coercion rule; this member does not define it a second time. An externally owned compatible extension may refine that algebra while preserving explicit indeterminate, out-of-frame and invalid-basis pressure; it may neither add a core member nor coerce one to success.
P5

A fresh competent actor inside the declared capability envelope can reconstruct the activated evaluation from the frame declaration, the exact subject, the basis and the admissible inputs, without undocumented conversational or historical context.
P0 with the actor-change premise

Frame adequacy includes actor usability. When the material manifold exceeds an actor's capability envelope, human authority may select another actor, refine the frame, sequence activations or provide a lawful compression (RF-017); the selection is human authority's, exercised directly or in advance through the grant, and ACTIVATION section 2 says which of these a step selects itself and which re-enter the grant's owner. The actor may not silently omit material relations to fit its context.
P0, P5

Coverage and evaluation results retain known uncertainty. Unresolved relations, uncovered evaluations, contested evidence and unknown capability stay explicit. Absence of a recorded counterexample is not evidence of universal completeness.
P4b, P6; open-world premise

REFERENCE_FRAME requires the declared relations and the observable outcomes. It requires no frame runtime, universal carrier, registry, controller, prompt format, repository layout, collaboration topology, worker count or software framework.
P2

A role, persona, abstraction or component may help construct or activate a frame and none is a reference frame by identity alone; one component may appear in several frames and one frame may cross several components.
P3, P6
Silent omission of required material to fit the envelope is never a lawful option.

A step is the activation of one reference frame, or one declared active frame configuration, on an exact subject. Its context is the projection of that activated frame to the actor; the corpus or the workspace is never the context. Intake, admission, applicability and activation are distinct relations inside the step even when one invocation performs all of them.

A step-produced fact is a judgment, residual, observation or authority decision produced by a step that cannot be re-acquired from declared sources; an observation reproducible from declared sources is re-acquirable, is not a step-produced fact, and is governed by sufficiency, not conservation.

A reference frame may be represented in prose, structured data, a prompt, a design asset, a typed carrier, a runtime context or any other form its consumer selects. No class, aggregate, actor, controller, service, registry, graph or frame engine is required.

Frame disjointness is structural; evaluation independence is procedural; assurance independence is claim-relative and stated by the governing assurance law (EVALUATION section 3). Disjoint frames need not be independently evaluated; independently activated evaluations need not be disjoint; and the unqualified word independent establishes none of the three.
P6, P1

A state-value change preserves the frame topology only when it preserves every entity, relation, lifecycle, authority, capability, adjacency and seam; a transition that changes any of them is a topology mutation that may invalidate the frame's coordinates. A frame need not hold the workspace's complete topology.
P3
The frame's internal working context is not transferred when the closed result and its provenance are sufficient for the consuming decision.
P4b, P0

frame_indexes.scope: Declare a reference frame for a given subject per the minimal frame declaration, activate it on an exact subject and basis as one bounded step, and return a minimal evaluation result: the frame objects and tuple, the laws a declaration must satisfy, the authority kinds, the activation packet and binding, the result algebra and closed result, and the qualification tests the declaration's Qualification section answers. Selected for the F-01 usability case, task A.
